memo.text: The interests and assumptions in this persona hang together. The same audience also leans toward Icebreaker, Ibex Outdoor Clothing, American Alpine Club, which could be useful for partners or marketing.
memo.ja: この想定客の好きなものと前提は、データ上きちんとまとまっています。同じ層は Icebreaker, Ibex Outdoor Clothing, American Alpine Club も好む傾向があり、提携先や宣伝先の候補になります。

next.en: Partner, sponsor or co-promote with: Icebreaker, Ibex Outdoor Clothing, American Alpine Club, Western Rise. Qloo shows these people over-index on them, though your plan didn't name them.
next.ja: 提携・広告・共同企画の候補：Icebreaker、Ibex Outdoor Clothing、American Alpine Club、Western Rise。計画書には無かったが、この層がよく好むと Qloo が示したものです。

next.en: Try Icebreaker and Ibex Outdoor Clothing as topics, collabs or references in your content and ads, and see which gets more response.
next.ja: Icebreaker や Ibex Outdoor Clothing をコンテンツや広告のネタ・コラボ・例えに使ってみて、どちらが反応が良いか比べる。

next.en: Target ads and outreach at ages 35–44.
next.ja: 広告や声かけの対象は 35〜44歳に絞る。

next.en: Paste the corrected persona into your plan, then test it with 5–10 real customers before you spend on it.
next.ja: 修正版の想定客を計画書に貼り、お金をかける前に実際のお客さん5〜10人で確かめる。
